what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Cyprus, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 246901 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
UNHCR's figures for people displaced inside Cyprus cover only 1993 to 1998, when it counted 265000 each year.

why.text: The sources here don't record the causes of this displacement: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Cyprus in them.
Wildfires are the disasters recorded for Cyprus in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 201000 in 2009 to a peak of 272400 in 2015.
IDMC records no new displacements from conflict in Cyprus in these years, so the figure describes people still living in displacement.

how.text: IDMC's and UNHCR's figures cover different years and are counted differently; they are never added.
IDMC's new displacements from disasters count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where inside Cyprus people live.
